what: A text list inside a fixed-height panel rises from the empty screen below (the first set is pushed down by the panel height) and flows endlessly upward 1px per frame — by pushing the panel’s scrollTop, not with transform, so scrolling up or down with the wheel or a finger continues flowing from that spot. On reaching the head of the second set it jumps to the head of the first, and pushing to the very top jumps to the head of the second set, so there is no seam. If one set is shorter than the panel, it is repeated and appended to fill the panel.

options.speed: Px pushed per frame, default 1 (the original is also per frame, not time — 60px per second at 60Hz)
options.start: below (default — first batch drops by the panel height and rises from an empty screen) or top (full from the start)
options.[data-fx-part=set]: The set to repeat (first child of the panel). A part is the second set (data-fx-part=clone, aria-hidden) is created and attached
options.fx:pause · fx:play: Shooting at the panel stops the flow and it flows again — when another screen covering that panel is showing (the original stops on subpages)

note: The panel needs a height (the part css applies overflow: auto and a hidden scrollbar). With reduced motion it does not flow and is just a scrollable list. Finger scrolling is not blocked on phones either

from.where: index.html .as-list — Home ‹Less ○○ / More ○○› two-column list (original infinite-scroll: scrollTop + 1 on every rAF, back to 1 at the end, first copy margin-top 100vh). Paused with fx:pause when moving to a subpage
